fields.title: Minimize sent data
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: A banking app assistant answers questions about spending. Decide what to send to the model and what to omit.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Available: name, card number, balance, list of transactions with amounts and merchants, address, phone number, customer ID.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Send — transaction categories and amounts, anonymized; user question. Do not send — name, card number, address, phone number, customer ID. Balance — debatable: needed to answer "how much do I have left", but you can inject it into the UI rather than generating it. Merchants — replace with categories unless the task requires specific names. Rule of thumb: data that is not sent cannot leak.
